en: Now we saw all the rules, we had a look at
all the rules, and I showed you a couple of
examples. Now it's time for your challenge.
So at Hatch'd you find the challenge.py
file, it's therefore written in Python,
and this file has some code. You can execute
it, though I will say it will fail. You can
fix it
and you'll find ideas on how to fix it in
the code file,
but the main priority is not that you fix
this file that you can execute it,
but that you fix the comments and the
formatting in the file.
Not everything is wrong. Indeed, it isn't
too bad, but there are a couple of things
which can be improved. And I want you to go
through this file, have a look at all the
different comments and the formatting and
the code you see here,
and see how you could improve it.
And then of course compare your solution to
mine so that you also see how I transformed
this file.
